title: Signal connections made in `@tool` scripts do not immediately appear in signal pane.
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 13 Mar 2025 18:12:00 +0000 on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (nvidia; 570.124.04) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700 CPU @ 3.60GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

I have a node with an attached `@tool` script which lets me connect a specific signal from that node to a specific method of a given target node via a setter method. When I do this, the signal is connected as expected, but the signal connection does not appear in the _Signals_ panel of the _Node_ dock. Only when I select a different node and then re-select the original node does the connection appear in the _Signals_ panel. Calling `notify_property_list_changed` from the script after connecting the signal _does not_ cause the connections in the _Signals_ panel to refresh.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the included MRP in the editor.
2. Open `issue_demo.tscn`.
3. Select `SignalNode` from the scene tree.
4. In the _Inspector_ dock, click _Assign..._ for the _Quick Connect_ property.
5. Select `TargetNode` (or any node, for that matter).
    1. Notice that the "signal" icon is shown next to `SignalNode` in the scene tree, indicating a signal has been connected.
6. Switch to the _Node_ dock and open the _Signals_ panel, if it is not already open.
    1. **Expected behavior:** The `my_signal` signal should show a connection to `../TargetNode :: print_tree()`.
    2. **Actual behavior:** No connection is shown under `my_signal`
7. Select any other node in the scene tree, then re-select `SignalNode`.
    1. Notice that the connection to `TargetNode` now appears in the _Signals_ panel for `SignalNode`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[signal_bug_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19470500/signal_bug_mrp.zip)
